thread:
Marie (Support): FYI customer Novaplay reported 403s and compliance alerts right after a failure window. They say requests for EU-pinned tenants are being served from us-west-2. Audit logs flagged a residency policy exception.

Ajay (SRE): Can you drop a request-id and a sample header dump? also when did the failover start?

Marie (Support): request-id: r-0a12b3c4d5e6f7g8, timestamp: 2026-04-12T10:23:14Z. From their audit: `policy_exception: residency_violation`, `served_region: us-west-2`, `required_region: eu-west-1`. Log snippet:```
{"req_id":"r-0a12b3c4d5e6f7g8","tenant":"novaplay","x-region-routed":"us-west-2","x-residency":"eu-west-1","status":403,"audit_reason":"policy_exception:residency_violation"}
```

Lina (Routing): ugh. We rolled a routing policy tweak in the EU router cluster yesterday morning (rollout id rpolicy-2026-04-11-3). That change flipped fallback strategy for some tenant groups. Might be falling back to ANY_REGION for short windows.

Ajay (SRE): Checking router mapping for tenant novaplay... hold on.

Deploy Bot: rollout rpolicy-2026-04-11-3 -> completed on eu-router-2 at 2026-04-11T09:12:08Z :white_check_mark:

Ajay (SRE): Found it. Tenant novaplay has config: `primary: eu-west-1`, `fallback: closest-available` (which resolves to us-west-2 during our cross-zone pressure spike). That contradicts residency flag which should enforce `fallback: same-region-only`.

Dom (Eng): How did config drift happen? We have a validation that should reject `closest-available` for tenants with residency=true. Someone must have bypassed the validation during the rollout.

Lina (Routing): We accidentally promoted an old staging policy to prod due to a tag collision. I'll pull the policy and revert. Quick mitigation: pin the tenant to eu-west-1 via override API until we patch the validation.

Ajay (SRE): Agreed. Local pin will stop further violations and silence audit alerts. Confirming a hotfix:
```
# pin tenant to EU while we roll patch
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/novaplay/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"routing_override":{"force_region":"eu-west-1","ttl_seconds":86400}}'
```

Marie (Support): I applied the override and asked customer to retry. They reported immediate success and audit alerts stopped for new requests. :thumbsup:

Compliance Bot: Audit alert created: A-2026-334-RESIDENCY for tenant novaplay. Severity: high. Suggested actions: export affected request logs, extend retention to 90 days, create policy exception ticket if needed.

Dom (Eng): Headline: root cause = accidental promotion of staging policy (tag collision) -> routing fallback became permissive -> cross-region failover during capacity spike -> residency policy exceptions + 403s.

Ajay (SRE): Also noticed a billing anomaly: egress for novaplay jumped ~42% in last hour because traffic flowed through us-west-2. Billing flagged an unusual charge for account acct-9987. I'll loop Billing.

Lina (Routing): I'll roll back the bad policy and add a stricter validation to the policy promotion pipeline (reject if any tenant with residency=true would get fallback != same-region-only).

Marie (Support): Notifying Novaplay support contact and legal compliance contact. They've asked for a timeline and proof that no customer data left EU.

Ajay (SRE): We have request traces and KV cache evidence showing the served tokens remained inside eu-west-1 after the pin. I'll attach traces to the incident.

Compliance Bot: Action items added to ticket A-2026-334-RESIDENCY: [export logs], [extend retention], [postmortem].

Dom (Eng): Creating follow-up: postmortem + policy pipeline fix. Assigning to Lina and Ajay.

Marie (Support): Creating incident INC-2026-453 and notifying account team. I'll draft the customer-facing timeline.

Lina (Routing): ETA on policy pipeline patch: will have a PR by EOD, plan to roll a validation hotfix tomorrow morning.

Ajay (SRE): I'll coordinate with Billing and Compliance to reconcile the egress charge and get customer credit pre-approved if needed.

Marie (Support): Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open until postmortem and billing cleared. :white_check_mark:
